scope:
One fixed model-chunk-aligned gate against saved baseline/legacy controls.

Three supplied recordings, a complete 320/30 ms phase cycle and fixed gains.
No tuning, real capture, action dispatch, allocator change, or promotion.

protocol.scope: One fixed aligned-onset candidate; no parameter search
protocol.expected_labels: Source keyword once per file; no extra triggers
protocol.timing_gate: No input trigger later than saved ungated baseline; retain every failing case
protocol.controls: Original quiet gate and current omitted-alignment behavior must match exact trigger chunks
protocol.additional_controls: Original surrogate/published/names negatives, long leading quiet and repeated recovery

baseline_snapshot.scope: Handoff snapshot of measured ungated KWS baseline; ignored workspace-only copies, not a release
